title: RIxiV1/Resume-Screening-Agent
description: AI-powered resume screening agent built with n8n and Lovable. Candidates upload a PDF resume and JD; the workflow extracts text, scores the match with an LLM, returns a structured report (score, summary, strengths, gaps, next steps), and can optionally send interview or rejection emails automatically.

title: Mesh-LLM/mesh-llm
description: Distributed AI/LLM for the people. Share compute privately or publicly to power your agents and chat.

title: JetBrains/junie
description: An AI coding agent by JetBrains that ships code from your terminal, IDE, or CI/CD pipeline - powered by any LLM you choose

title: weam-ai/weam
description: Web app for teams of 20+ members. In-built connections to major LLMs via API. Share chats, prompts, and agents in team or private folders. Modern, fully responsive stack (Next.js, Node.js). Deploy your own vibe-coded AI apps, agents, or workflows or use ready-made solutions from the library.

title: jdorner/palim
description: Self-hosted AI agent platform with extensions, workflows, and a web UI. Local LLM inference via llama.cpp (or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint).

title: Osmantic/ODS
description: Turn your PC, Mac, or Linux box into an AI server.  LLM inference, chat UI, voice, agents, workflows, RAG, and image generation.

title: bgill55/daedalus
description: Daedalus is a standalone terminal-based AI coding assistant that runs on your machine. It connects to local LLM servers (LM Studio, Ollama, llama.cpp, vLLM) or remote providers (OpenAI, Groq, OpenRouter, Anthropic), routes requests intelligently, and gives your AI agent access to your file system, terminal, git, web search, and codebase indexing

title: tjpoisal/UNIMATRIX
description: Unimatrix is a cloud-native AI memory system that gives any LLM instant, persistent context across devices and sessions. Built around the Model Context Protocol (MCP), it eliminates the need to re-explain context every time you switch tools or devices. Dual-layer mem, hybrid retrieval w/ recency decay, a Librarian agent, and enterprise encryption.

title: jvmind/jvmind-ce
description: AI-powered JVM diagnostics agent. Analyze GC logs, jstack thread dumps, and heap dumps via local LLM (Ollama) or OpenAI-compatible APIs. Single-user, local-first, open source.

title: mockagents/mockagents
description: Simulate, test, and validate AI agent integrations — without calling real LLMs or burning tokens.

title: openonion/oo-chat
description: Open-source chat client for AI agents. Connect to ConnectOnion agents or use LLM APIs directly.

title: lucasmailland/mnemosyne
description: Cognitive memory for AI agents. Bitemporal, multi-tenant Postgres + pgvector. Hybrid recall (BM25 + vectors + graph) with BYO LLM. Use as a library, HTTP API, or MCP server.

title: AlfaroDev/SQL-AI-assistant-agent
description: An agent-based AI SQL assistant that translates natural language into safe, validated SQL queries using LangChain and a locally-run open-source LLM (Ollama), with no API keys or paid services required.

title: artokun/comfyui-mcp-panel
description: The local-first sidebar AI agent for ComfyUI — runs on your own Claude OR ChatGPT subscription (no API keys, no extra LLM costs). Drives your live graph: edits, workflows & installs in natural language. The panel UI for comfyui-mcp, the agent-native control plane for ComfyUI.

title: synapseorch-ai/synapse-ai
description: Build AI agents that actually do things. Synapse is an open-source platform for creating, connecting, and orchestrating AI agents powered by any LLM — local, cloud or CLIs.

title: albert-matheww/claimsentry
description: ClaimSentry is a multi-agent AI pipeline for expense fraud and compliance triage. It extracts receipt data, checks company policies via RAG, detects semantic duplicate claims with embeddings + pgvector, and uses LangGraph to approve or escalate claims. Includes offline LLM fallback, MCP tools, evidence trails, and evaluation metrics.

title: Resolve-public/writing-assistant-chat
description: AI writing assistant for Obsidian with chat, plan, and edit modes. Connects to local or cloud LLM providers. Features vault-wide RAG retrieval, knowledge graph, agentic tool use, note context, and reusable prompt commands.

title: padosory5/Local-LLM-elaina-
description: 【 Electron x Live2d x Piper x Ollama 】 Open LLM Model named Elaina is a personal AI agent in a desktop application tha utilizes AI agents in order to give responses or complete tasks for the user

title: mozgsml/memgres
description: Drop-in memory layer for AI agents on a single Postgres. Store documents (not LLM-guessed facts), edit by whole body or unified diff with content-hash optimistic concurrency, organize as an ltree tree, recall lexically or semantically (pgvector) or hybrid, git-blame every line, reconstruct any version, erase for real. Library + HTTP + MCP. MIT.

title: ashok-kallara/semantic-daily
description: A 100% free agentic news aggregator that discovers trending AI & technology content from Native APIs (Reddit, Bluesky, GitHub, RSS, HackerNews, YouTube, and Exa.ai) — deduplicates, categorizes using a multi-agent LLM pipeline over OpenRouter, and delivers a curated daily digest directly to your Telegram or as a Web Dashboard.
